description: Publish an incident on status pages, with its first update. Public, and emailed to subscribers unless notify_subscribers is false: confirm the wording with the user first. To record an incident internally and page on-call instead, use create_outage.

affected_components.description: Services shown as affected: their UUIDs from get_status_page (mon_..., comp_... or agt_... for servers).

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the text is written in, e.g. "fr". Defaults to the status page's default language.

message.description: Public text of the update, shown on the status page and sent to subscribers. Basic HTML allowed.

notify_subscribers.description: Email/SMS/Slack/Teams the status page subscribers. Default true.

status.description: Stage of the first update. Default "investigating".

status_pages.description: UUIDs of the status pages to publish on (list_status_pages).

title.description: Public headline, e.g. "Elevated API error rates".

type.description: "incident" for degraded service, "outage" for services down. Default "incident".

name: create_status_page_incident
title: Publish status page incident
